note: What a server sends to make a unit play an animation. The header names the unit.

bits.name: locked
bits.note: Set where no other animation may fade this one out.

bits.name: lockedFromIdle
bits.note: Set where idle animations may not fade it out; read only where locked is clear.

bits.name: noBlend
bits.note: Set to switch to it at once rather than blend in.

bits.name: keepEmotes
bits.note: Set to let an emote playing go on; clear stops it.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: scaleTime
fields.note: A scale on how long it plays.

fields.name: startProgress
fields.note: How far into the animation it starts.

fields.name: animation
fields.note: The animation's name, ended by a zero byte. A client reads it from a 64-byte field, so the name and its zero take at most 64 bytes; a name the unit has not is logged and nothing plays.

revisions.note: scaleTime and startProgress are applied only where above zero. A unit holding a locked animation ignores the message. An animated building plays at normal speed and reads nothing of keepEmotes.
